lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਝੂਠੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dar ghar dhoee na lahai daragah jhooth khuaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In this world, you shall not find any shelter; in the world hereafter, being false, you shall suffer. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਭੁਲਈ ਸਚਾ ਵਡ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap sujaan na bhulaee sachaa vad kirasaan ||
lines.translation: The True Lord Himself knows all; He makes no mistakes. He is the Great Farmer of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਦਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pahilaa dharatee saadh kai sach naam de daan ||
lines.translation: First, He prepares the ground, and then He plants the Seed of the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: nau nidh upajai naam ek karam pavai neesaan ||2||
lines.translation: The nine treasures are produced from Name of the One Lord. By His Grace, we obtain His Banner and Insignia. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਜਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਜੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kau jaan na jaanaee kiaa tis chaj achaar ||
lines.translation: Some are very knowledgeable, but if they do not know the Guru, then what is the use of their lives?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhulai naam visaariaa manamukh a(n)dh gubaar ||
lines.translation: The blind have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The self-willed manmukhs are in utter darkness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan na chukaee mar janamai hoi khuaar ||3||
lines.translation: Their comings and goings in reincarnation do not end; through death and rebirth, they are wasting away. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨੁ ਮੋਲਿ ਅਣਾਇਆ ਕੁੰਗੂ ਮਾਂਗ ਸੰਧੂਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: cha(n)dan mol anaaiaa ku(n)goo maa(n)g sa(n)dhoor ||
lines.translation: The bride may buy sandalwood oil and perfumes, and apply them in great quantities to her hair;

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਘਣਾ ਪਾਨਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਪੂਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: choaa cha(n)dan bahu ghanaa paanaa naal kapoor ||
lines.translation: she may sweeten her breath with betel leaf and camphor,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਧਨ ਕੰਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਤ ਸਭਿ ਅਡੰਬਰ ਕੂੜੁ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: je dhan ka(n)t na bhaavaee ta sabh ada(n)bar kooR ||4||
lines.translation: but if this bride is not pleasing to her Husband Lord, then all these trappings are false. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਬਾਦਿ ਹਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ras bhogan baad hahi sabh seegaar vikaar ||
lines.translation: Her enjoyment of all pleasures is futile, and all her decorations are corrupt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਭੇਦੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਸੋਹੈ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab lag sabad na bhedeeai kiu sohai guraduaar ||
lines.translation: Until she has been pierced through with the Shabad, how can she look beautiful at Guru's Gate?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੫॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak dha(n)n suhaaganee jin sah naal piaar ||5||13||
lines.translation: O Nanak, blessed is that fortunate bride, who is in love with her Husband Lord. ||5||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਞੀ ਦੇਹ ਡਰਾਵਣੀ ਜਾ ਜੀਉ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)njee deh daraavanee jaa jeeu vichahu jaai ||
lines.translation: The empty body is dreadful, when the soul goes out from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਹਿ ਬਲੰਦੀ ਵਿਝਵੀ ਧੂਉ ਨ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਕਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaahi bala(n)dee vijhavee dhoou na nikasio kaai ||
lines.translation: The burning fire of life is extinguished, and the smoke of the breath no longer emerges.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚੇ ਰੁੰਨੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਭਰੇ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)che ru(n)ne dukh bhare binase doojai bhaai ||1||
lines.translation: The five relatives (the senses) weep and wail painfully, and waste away through the love of duality. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂੜੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mooRe raam japahu gun saar ||
lines.translation: You fool: chant the Name of the Lord, and preserve your virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਸਭ ਮੁਠੀ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai mamataa mohanee sabh muthee aha(n)kaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Egotism and possessiveness are very enticing; egotistical pride has plundered everyone. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee naam visaariaa doojee kaarai lag ||
lines.translation: Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are attached to affairs of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਲਾਗੇ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dubidhaa laage pach mue a(n)tar trisanaa ag ||
lines.translation: Attached to duality, they putrefy and die; they are filled with the fire of desire within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਠਗਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur raakhe se ubare hor muthee dha(n)dhai thag ||2||
lines.translation: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved; all others are cheated and plundered by deceitful worldly affairs. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਈ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਗਇਆ ਮੁਆ ਵੈਰੁ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: muee pareet piaar gaiaa muaa vair virodh ||
lines.translation: Love dies, and affection vanishes. Hatred and alienation die.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਥਕਾ ਹਉ ਮੁਈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)dhaa thakaa hau muee mamataa maaiaa krodh ||
lines.translation: Entanglements end, and egotism dies, along with attachment to Maya, possessiveness and anger.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰੋਧੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: karam milai sach paaeeai guramukh sadaa nirodh ||3||
lines.translation: Those who receive His Mercy obtain the True One. The Gurmukhs dwell forever in balanced restraint. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachee kaarai sach milai guramat palai paai ||
lines.translation: By true actions, the True Lord is met, and the Guru's Teachings are found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਨਰੁ ਜੰਮੈ ਨਾ ਮਰੈ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: so nar ja(n)mai naa marai naa aavai naa jaai ||
lines.translation: Then, they are not subject to birth and death; they do not come and go in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਸੋ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak dar paradhaan so daragahi paidhaa jaai ||4||14||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they are respected at the Lord's Gate; they are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahal 1 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਮਾਟੀ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੂਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan jal bal maatee bhaiaa man maaiaa mohi manoor ||
lines.translation: The body is burnt to ashes; by its love of Maya, the mind is rusted through.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਗਣ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਾਗੂ ਭਏ ਕੂਰਿ ਵਜਾਵੈ ਤੂਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: augan phir laagoo bhae koor vajaavai toor ||
lines.translation: Demerits become one's enemies, and falsehood blows the bugle of attack.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਡੋਬੇ ਪੂਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabadai bharamaaeeai dubidhaa dobe poor ||1||
lines.translation: Without the Word of the Shabad, people wander lost in reincarnation. Through the love of duality, multitudes have been drowned. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man re sabad tarahu chit laai ||
lines.translation: O mind, swim across, by focusing your consciousness on the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin guramukh naam na boojhiaa mar janamai aavai jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Those who do not become Gurmukh do not understand the Naam; they die, and continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਸੂਚਾ ਸੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan soochaa so aakheeai jis mahi saachaa naau ||
lines.translation: That body is said to be pure, in which the True Name abides.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai sach raatee dehuree jihavaa sach suaau ||
lines.translation: One whose body is imbued with the Fear of the True One, and whose tongue savors Truthfulness,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sachee nadar nihaaleeai bahuR na paavai taau ||2||
lines.translation: is brought to ecstasy by the True Lord's Glance of Grace. That person does not have to go through the fire of the womb again. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਪਵਨਾ ਭਇਆ ਪਵਨੈ ਤੇ ਜਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saache te pavanaa bhaiaa pavanai te jal hoi ||
lines.translation: From the True Lord came the air, and from the air came water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal te tribhavan saajiaa ghat ghat jot samoi ||
lines.translation: From water, He created the three worlds; in each and every heart He has infused His Light.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: niramal mailaa naa theeai sabad rate pat hoi ||3||
lines.translation: The Immaculate Lord does not become polluted. Attuned to the Shabad, honor is obtained. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu man saach sa(n)tokhiaa nadar kare tis maahi ||
lines.translation: One whose mind is contented with Truthfulness, is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace.
